messages.author: 96cb4a9ee463ef5d
messages.subject: Rqtl2 input file issues
parts:
Hi Rqtl group,
 
I just started on working through the qtl2 program and I have already hit a snag. My data is currently in rqtl format and I was planning on using convert2cross2() to get the data into rqut2 format. Currently my genotypes are coded as AA, AB, and - and saved as a csv but when I read in the data I get the error:

The following unexpected genotype codes were treated as missing.
    |AA|AB|
 --Read the following data:
81  individuals
2195  markers
5  phenotypes
There is no genotype data!

Is there something I'm missing?
Thanks,
Dani

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Rqtl2 input file issues
parts:
In read.cross(), use genotypes=c("AA","AB") (The default is for the genotypes to be coded as A/H/B.)

karl
